text:
rachel_acme: Hi team — after accepting invite our engineer can view the project but when they try to edit project settings (name/labels) the UI shows view-only and API returns a 403. Project: acme-web, org: acme-inc. Support ticket #78921.

maria_support: @rachel_acme sorry about that — can you paste the exact curl you used and the response (headers + body)? Also what role shows up in the Console for that user?

rachel_acme: cURL we ran: ```curl -X PATCH https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/1234 -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"Acme Web - new"}'```
Response: ```HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
content-type: application/json
x-request-id: rq_7a1b2c

{"error":"permission_denied","message":"caller lacks project.update permission"}```

devon_platform: @maria_support / @rachel_acme two quick checks: 1) is that token a user/session token or a service/project scoped token? 2) did the SCIM/group -> role mapping change recently? We shipped a scope-trimming change for some SSO flows.

rachel_acme: It's a user session token (web login). In Console the account shows role: "Viewer" even though in Okta we added them to group mapped to Editor. We tried removing and re-adding the user, no change. Okta is the IdP and SCIM sync shows last sync ~10m ago.

maria_support: Please run: ```GET https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/1234/rolebindings -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED'``` and paste the body. Also sending us the x-request-id helps (we'll correlate logs).

rachel_acme: x-request-id: rq_7a1b2c. Rolebindings returned: ```{"bindings":[{"principal":"okta:user:U123","role":"viewer"}]}```

devon_platform: That response suggests the SCIM mapping didn't apply. Usually causes: group name mismatch, SCIM group rename, or Okta claim mapping changed (group prefix/suffix trimmed). If your Okta group was renamed (dash -> underscore) the mapping rule could fail and default to Viewer.

rachel_acme: Hmm — we did rename a group earlier. Okta shows group name "acme-admins" but SCIM entries show "acme_admins" (underscore). Could that be the issue? :thinking_face:

maria_support: Yes — our RBAC sync is exact-match on group name (we don't fuzzy-match). Workarounds: 1) add the user directly as Editor in Console (owner action) or 2) trigger a manual resync so our mapping picks up the corrected group-to-role mapping. I can run a resync for org acme-inc if you want — will push the latest SCIM snapshot through.

rachel_acme: Please do the resync — we tried re-inviting but that didn't update bindings.

oncall-bot: Incident note: org-acme-sync-resync triggered by maria_support at 2024-06-15T11:34:20Z — job id sync-20240615-983. Logs: https://internal.redwood/integrations/scim/jobs/sync-20240615-983

devon_platform: After the resync finishes, re-check the rolebindings and retry the PATCH. If the sync job shows the group mapping present but bindings unchanged we'll escalate to the sync-service owners.

maria_support: Resync complete — job shows group "acme_admins" mapped to Editor and user U123 was added to the project binding. Can you verify?

rachel_acme: Verified. rolebindings now returns Editor and the PATCH worked (no 403). Thanks so much! :tada:
